note: First-pass extension proposal; not merged into shared sources.json. Local hashes are SHA-256. Full-text access does not imply computational reproduction.

sources.title: DESI DR2 Results II: BAO and cosmological constraints
sources.role: Primary DR2 BAO likelihood and collaboration cosmology reference.

sources.title: Extended dark-energy analysis using DESI DR2 BAO
sources.locators: Table I p. 5; Eq. (6) p. 7; Sec. III pp. 8-9.
sources.role: Companion source for priors, model and perturbation-code conventions; not independent data confirmation.

sources.title: DESI DR2 Ly-alpha BAO Results I
sources.role: Earlier compressed Ly-alpha BAO result; same DR2 data family as the later full-shape/AP analysis.
sources.limitation: Do not combine as an independent point with Results IV fullshape absent a released joint covariance/likelihood.

sources.title: The Dark Energy Survey Supernova Program: A Reanalysis of Cosmology Results and Evidence for Evolving Dark Energy with an Updated Type Ia Supernova Calibration
sources.role: Updated SN recalibration and separate analysis branch that supersedes and overlaps older SN fits.
sources.limitation: Repository mutable; pin commit. Do not treat old DES-SN5YR and Dovekie as independent (1718 overlapping SNe).

sources.title: The Atacama Cosmology Telescope: DR6 power spectra, likelihoods and Lambda-CDM parameters
sources.locators: Eq. (17) p. 22; Eq. (33) p. 25; P-ACT definition Sec. 6.3 pp. 26-27.
sources.role: CMB likelihood and overlap contract. ACT spectra, ACT-lite and P-ACT are alternatives, not separate independent factors.

sources.title: DES-SN5YR/Dovekie release repository
sources.version: Mutable repository accessed 2026-09-24; no commit pinned in this pass
sources.access: release README and artifact index checked
sources.role: Distance vectors, covariance, systematic components, likelihood and chain locations.
sources.limitation: Repository is mutable. Dovekie overlaps the original DES-SN5YR sample and should replace, not be added to, that release.

sources.title: NASA LAMBDA ACT DR6.02 products
sources.role: Maps, spectra, covariance, chains and likelihood links.

sources.title: DESI DR2 Results IV: Alcock-Paczynski Measurements from the Lyman Alpha Forest and Cosmological Constraints
sources.locators: Eqs. (20)-(26), printed pp. 18-20; Sec. VI.D/Table IV pp. 24-27; Data Availability p. 30.
sources.role: Latest DR2 Ly-alpha full-shape/AP result and updated cosmology comparison.
sources.limitation: Exact joint likelihood link not located in first pass. Updated BAO+Ly-alpha FS replaces the Ly-alpha BAO point; avoid double-counting.

sources.title: DESI DR2 Ly-alpha forest full-shape validation companion
sources.role: Companion mock/data-split validation; same collaboration and survey sample, not independent replication.

sources.title: Field equation of thermodynamic gravity and galactic rotational curves
sources.version: Physics of the Dark Universe 46 (2024) 101660; DOI 10.1016/j.dark.2024.101660
sources.access: local full journal PDF; Eq. (1) visually checked
sources.role: Supplied primary source for constant-K equation and conditional NGC 3198 fit.
sources.limitation: Spherical approximation and observed endpoint velocities used as derivative boundary values; no public analysis code located.

sources.title: Field equation of thermodynamic gravity and galactic rotational curves
sources.role: Preprint companion to journal source; equation/method/boundary details.
sources.limitation: Journal Eq. (1) checked visually; versions not asserted byte-identical.

sources.title: SPARC: Mass Models for 175 Disk Galaxies
sources.role: Rotation-curve and baryon component data lineage.
sources.limitation: Disk/gas force components do not uniquely determine a positive spherical density.

sources.title: Evidence for evolving dark energy from DESI DR2 BAO and Pantheon+, DES-Dovekie, and Union3
sources.role: Alternative SimpleMC/dynesty inference and sensitivity result on overlapping public data.
sources.limitation: Different priors/data treatment; not a new survey extraction or fully independent observation.

sources.title: Baryon Acoustic Oscillations from a Different Angle
sources.role: Methodological/interpretive critique of BAO-based evolving-DE preference.
sources.limitation: Alternative analysis of public BAO information, not independent survey measurement or official correction.

sources.title: Evolving Dark Energy or Supernovae Systematics?
sources.role: Historical SN calibration-sensitivity motivation; later Dovekie directly re-calibrates DES sample.

sources.title: Did DESI DR2 truly reveal dynamical dark energy?
sources.role: Critique of significance interpretation; method not audited in this pass.

sources.title: Emergence of extended Newtonian gravity from thermodynamics
sources.role: Backward theoretical lineage for thermodynamic gravity and relaxation.

sources.title: Crossover in extended Newtonian gravity emerging from thermodynamics
sources.role: Backward lineage for nonlinear/singular vacuum solutions and force crossover.
